tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The DBC 1GE FTTH XPON ONU is a compact and reliable dual-mode GPON/EPON optical network unit designed for fast and stable fiber broadband connections. Featuring a single Gigabit Ethernet port, this ONU ensures smooth data transfer and excellent performance for home users, small offices, and ISP deployments. It supports automatic GPON and EPON detection, making it compatible with most OLT brands used across Bangladesh.


With an SC/UPC optical interface, efficient data processing, and advanced security features such as MAC filtering, ACL, and DoS/DDoS protection, the DBC 1GE XPON ONU ensures safe and uninterrupted network operation. The device is energy-efficient, easy to install, and comes in a durable, lightweight design that fits seamlessly into any FTTH setup.


Whether you're upgrading your fiber internet connection or looking for a dependable ONU for customer distribution, the DBC 1GE FTTH XPON ONU is a cost-effective and high-quality choice available at D CORE.


Key Features

  • Dual Mode xPON Support – Automatically compatible with both GPON and EPON networks.
  • Single Gigabit LAN Port – Provides 10/100/1000 Mbps high-speed Ethernet output.
  • FTTH Ready – Ideal for Fiber-To-The-Home deployments.
  • SC/UPC Connector – Ensures stable optical signal transmission.
  • Advanced Security – Supports firewall, ACL, MAC filtering, URL filtering, and DDoS protection.
  • Easy Installation – Lightweight, compact design suitable for home and office use.
  • Low Power Consumption – Operates efficiently with a 12V 0.5A adapter.
  • Broad OLT Compatibility – Works with Huawei, ZTE, VSOL, Raisecom, FiberHome & more.
